tax.title: Tax information
tax.subtitle: Seller identity so XePrime can declare tax correctly when required.
tax.entityHint: Whether and how XePrime withholds or remits tax depends on the seller type and on tax advice. Any rate will be announced before it takes effect; nothing is preset here.
tax.residencyBody: XePrime doesn't store residency yet. If a resident / non-resident classification becomes necessary for tax filing, the platform will ask separately when real tax settings are configured.
tax.idNumberHint: ID number of the person the profile is registered to.
tax.fullProfile: Bank account and full identity documents are declared in the seller profile.
tax.viewOnly: You can only view this information.

dataProtection.title: Data protection
dataProtection.heading: Peace of mind with XePrime
dataProtection.intro: A summary of what XePrime does with your data, per the Privacy Policy in force.

points.location: Location data is only used to find vehicles near you and to compute delivery distance.
points.bank: Bank account details are only used for payouts and refunds, as required by law.
points.masking: Phone numbers and identity documents are masked on every screen that does not need them.
points.rights: You can view, correct and request deletion of your data.

dataProtection.commitment: XePrime is committed to protecting and using personal data transparently, securely and in line with the law.
dataProtection.consentNote: This summary is read-only. Per-item consent toggles will arrive once the platform can store your choices — it cannot yet.

changePassword.title: Security update
changePassword.subtitle: Update your password to keep your account safe.
changePassword.firstTimeTitle: Set a password for the first time
changePassword.firstTimeBody: This account signs in with OTP or a social login, so it has no password yet. Set one to sign in faster next time — no current password needed.
changePassword.successFirstTime: Password set. You can sign in with it next time.

deleteAccount.title: Request account deletion
deleteAccount.subtitle: Send a request for XePrime to delete your account.
deleteAccount.warningTitle: This is a request, handled manually by XePrime
deleteAccount.warningBody: After sending it you can keep signing in as usual until XePrime confirms and completes the deletion. You can withdraw the request while it is pending.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Once the request is accepted, the following will be handled per the Privacy Policy and applicable retention obligations:
deleteAccount.retentionNote: Some data (invoices, tax documents, transaction logs) may have to be kept for a legally required period before it is fully deleted.
deleteAccount.acknowledge: I understand this is a deletion request and XePrime will contact me and process it according to its procedure.
deleteAccount.confirmPhraseLabel: Confirm by typing the phrase below
deleteAccount.caseDescription: The user submitted an account deletion request from the account area.
deleteAccount.pendingBody: Request {code}. XePrime will reach out via the email or phone number on your account if further verification is needed.
deleteAccount.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this request? Your account stays as it is.
deleteAccount.loadError: Couldn't check for an existing request.
